intro: "Rot Hide Origins" is a Forsaken quest bridging the research of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Silverpine forest with the sorcerous expertise of the Undercity. After analyzing putrid fluids taken from gnolls, Apothecary Renferrel sends an adventurer to consult Bethor Iceshard to uncover the magical lineage behind these rotting beasts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components. My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity. Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.
Go. You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My studies require great concentration. So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This substance is laced with powerful spells, some of which I have not seen for a long, long time...
One moment—I must invoke a spell of divination...
